verdict.rationale: WezTerm documents a `wezterm cli` subcommand that talks to a running GUI or multiplexer instance and can spawn programs and manipulate tabs and panes, which covers the core of scripting the terminal from the command line. missing for 10: explicit evidence of sending text into panes, explicit evidence of querying state (e.g. listing windows or panes), detailed per-command documentation in the pack, independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI scripting.
